The plant can black-start a nearby gas turbine, which the grid operator tests twice a year. Weather data from a nearby station is used to forecast charging opportunities a day ahead. The connection agreement limits export during summer evenings when the line is congested. Recycling partners have agreed to take back modules at the end of their service life.

Earlier feasibility studies considered pumped hydro, which the terrain made too expensive. The developers published a lessons-learned report covering procurement and grid connection.
